target_customer: Individual knowledge workers and prosumers who want one place for notes, tasks and files
problem: People collect notes, tasks and files across many tools and lose track of what matters; Capture pitched one fast workspace for all of it.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer productivity app (pricing not found)

founders.name: Calvin LeGassick
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO; later shows 'Building at Blueprint'. No detailed background found.

exit.reason: The capture.so site states only that Capture is no longer available and thanks supporters; no cause given.

technical_complexity.rationale: A notes, tasks and files workspace is mostly standard app engineering; speed and sync across devices were the harder parts for a four person team.

defensibility.rationale: Note and task apps were easy to copy and users could export to established tools; no data, network or integration lock-in is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established note and workspace products already covered the wedge in 2019; Notion reported 1 million users in September 2019 (per a Wikipedia mirror). No source describes a specific incumbent action against Capture.

market_need_then: Fragmented personal information across notes, tasks and files was a common complaint, but sources found here give no dated evidence of demand for this specific product.

branding.domain_note: Used capture.so, not an exact .com; no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: YC copy: 'your operating system for life'; site copy at shutdown: 'Never lose a thought'.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or merch about the brand was found; many unrelated products share the name Capture, so search for it returns other apps.

outcome_analysis: Capture entered YC in Winter 2019 as a four person New York team building a unified notes, tasks and files workspace and is now inactive; its site says the service is no longer available. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned. The category was crowded with Evernote and Notion in 2019, but that is context and not a sourced cause.
notes: Cause search found nothing about Capture itself. Unverified: StartupIntros lists a $1M seed led by General Catalyst on 2019-07-16 for a company named Capture, but it gives no product description and other General Catalyst backed companies called Capture exist (a 2018 camera chat app), so it is not recorded as a round. The capture.so page shows a 2025 copyright for Eleventh, Inc. and tagline 'Never lose a thought', so the domain may have been repurposed; relationship to the YC team is unclear. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found. Search tool returned mostly unrelated shutdowns.
